name: Jiang Chengxue
source:
Occupation: A law school freshman, she came to the mountain with the protagonist because of the job.
Talents: Her smile can take away all your worries. Otherwise she has no particular talents.
Personality: A nice girl, she has conditional trust in and support for Xianchong.
Dream: Marry Xianchong someday.
Experience: Her family is a secret, but she can make desserts in real life. She has a part-time job at a cafe to support her studies, but Xianchong does not know where the cafe is.
Why she came: To support Xianchong in case of danger...
